VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate 0d2196ddf0d6ebca0ced6f271a8b27e17a67ea98 against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc after confirming HEAD and reading the complete diff, touched files and tests; per-criterion verdicts: AC-1 NOT SATISFIED (specs/pilot/spec.md:21 requires min, but src/math.mjs:68-73 adds only count and test/math.test.mjs:85-90 tests only count), R-1 SATISFIED for the new count function (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 SATISFIED for count (src/math.mjs:69-72), R-3 SATISFIED (existing functions unchanged and only existing test line changed is test/math.test.mjs:3), R-4 SATISFIED (complete diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, with no dependency or generated-file changes), R-5 SATISFIED for count (test/math.test.mjs:85,88).
Finding HIGH — src/math.mjs:68 and test/math.test.mjs:85: the candidate supplies count instead of the min API required by AC-1, leaving min unavailable and its required result, validation and nonmutation untested; this prevents AC-1 consumers from calling the required function, and the smallest verification is to export min, assert min([3,1,2]) equals 1, cover R-1 invalid inputs and R-2 unchanged input with min-prefixed tests, then run those tests and the full suite.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^count" test/ exited 0 with "count of several values", "count rejects invalid input", "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing with "15 !== 10", an explicitly excluded unchanged baseline defect; additional node -e probes exited 0 with "AC-1 min export: undefined" and "count validation/nonmutation probes: PASS" for invalid shapes, nonfinite/nonnumeric elements, sparse arrays, empty arrays and frozen input; the initial heredoc probe could not run because the read-only sandbox refused its temporary file, then the equivalent inline probe ran successfully; remaining uncertainty is the brief naming count while the pinned criterion requires min, with no edits or durable report created and repair or scope reconciliation left to the coordinator.
